text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
الدور الاول احيائي / 2023 / June

Q1) Reading Comprehension: (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

Smoking causes lung cancer. Lung cancer is the number one cancer among men. Ninety percent of the people who get lung cancer die. Smokers have six times as much cancer of the mouth, tongue and throat as nonsmokers. Smoking gives people breathing problems. It harms the stomach. Smokers pollute the air. They breathe it out on their children and on their wives or husbands. Children whose parents smoke have more breathing and lung problems than other children. Smokers have the right to kill themselves by smoking if they want to. They don't have the right to kill their wives and children by smoking. Young people start smoking because everyone else is doing it. They feel grown up and independent. It helps them relax. Then it becomes a habit. It is very difficult to stop smoking, but the chance of getting lung cancer decreases only one year after one stops smoking. After ten years, the chance is almost the same as for nonsmokers.

التدخين يسبب سرطان الرئة. وسرطان الرئة هو السرطان رقم واحد بين الرجال، ويموت تسعون في المئة من الأشخاص الذين يصابون بسرطان الرئة. يصاب المدخنون بسرطان الفم واللسان والحنجرة ستة أضعاف غير المدخنين. ويسبب التدخين مشاكل في التنفس. ويضر بالمعدة. يلوث المدخنون الهواء. ويتنفسونه على أطفالهم وعلى زوجاتهم أو أزواجهم. ويعاني الأطفال الذين يدخن أولياء أمورهم من مشاكل في التنفس والرئة أكثر من الأطفال الآخرين. وللمدخنين الحق في قتل أنفسهم بالتدخين إذا أرادوا ذلك. ولكن ليس من حقهم قتل زوجاتهم وأطفالهم بالتدخين. يبدأ الشباب في التدخين لأن الجميع يفعلون ذلك. ويشعرون بأنهم أصبحوا كباراً ومستقلين، ويساعدهم التدخين على الاسترخاء. ثم يصبح عادة. من الصعب جداً الإقلاع عن التدخين، لكن فرصة الإصابة بسرطان الرئة تقل فقط بعد عام واحد من التوقف عن التدخين. وبعد عشر سنوات، تصبح الفرصة مساوية تقريباً لغير المدخنين.

1. Why do young people smoke?
2. How many people die when they get lung cancer?
3. What happens to children when their parents smoke?
4. What is the chance of getting lung cancer ten years after a person stops smoking?
5. What does smoking do to the body?
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer or complete (5) of the following sentences using information from your text book: (10 M.)
1. Our families and friends feel that we care about them when we …………………..
2. What was waiting on the shore?
3. When do people get a lot of interest of their saving accounts?
4. When Mustafa couldn't help his mother, he decided to …………………..
5. The writer has learnt a lot about how body language is important in interviews. (True / False)
6. The amount of money an interpreter gets depends on ………………… and ………………….

Q2) Grammar and Functions: (30 Marks)
A/ Rewrite the following sentences, follow the instructions between brackets. (Choose 10)   (20 M.)
1. I always go to that garage for repairs. It was closed today. (Use the correct relative pronoun to make a defining relative clause)
2. Define a nurse. Use "look after sick people and help doctors"
3. ………………. An average of eight hours a night is about right. (Use an imperative to give advice)
4. You've painted the house blue. Now you think it doesn't look good. Blue was the wrong colour. (Regret. use: "I wish")
5. Would you like to come to see the new film with us? Thanks for asking, but I ………………..(Complete the response using "already" and an appropriate verb)
6. I (like) travelling, but now I (not / like) it anymore. (Use "used to" and the present or past simple)
7. I'm tired. I just walked all the way back from the shops. (Correct the sentence)
8. Somebody cleans the room every day.(Rewrite in the passive form)
9. I'm very disappointed to hear that the health club is closing down: I was ………………. (Future in the past)
10. Where did you lose your purse? I asked her ……………………. (Reported question)
11. Luckily, Sharifa (not drive) very fast when the child (run) into the road. (Put one verb in the past continuous and one in the past simple)
12. I (learn) to parachute if my friend (say) she would do it with me. (Write in the second conditional using the verbs in brackets)

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
الدور الاول ادبي تطبيقي / 2023 / June

Q1) Reading Comprehension: ( 20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

We talk about time every day. We measure it by the second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year and century. But what is time? No one can say exactly what it is. It is one of the greatest mysteries of our lives. We don't know exactly what time is, but our ability to measure it is very important. It makes our way of life possible. Time lets us put things in a definite order. It enables us to organise our lives. The earliest people saw changes around them. They saw day and night, the changes of the moon, and the seasons. They started measuring their lives by these changes. Then people started inventing clocks. Some clocks were beautiful. They had very complicated moving parts. Some had figures of people or animals. Others played music. Today's clocks and watches have quartz crystals. They are very accurate. Clocks change the way we look at the world. Clocks measure time, but nobody knows what it is.

نتحدث عن الوقت كل يوم، نقيسه بالثانية والدقيقة والساعة واليوم والأسبوع والشهر والسنة والقرن. ولكن ما هو الوقت؟ لا أحد يستطيع أن يقول بالضبط ما هو الوقت. إنه أحد أعظم الغموض في حياتنا. نحن لا نعرف بالضبط ما هو الوقت، لكن قدرتنا على قياسه مهمة جداً. يجعل نمط حياتنا ممكناً. يسمح لنا الوقت بوضع الأشياء في ترتيب محدد. إنه يمكننا تنظيم حياتنا. رأى أقدم الناس تغيرات حولهم. رأوا الليل والنهار، وتغيرات القمر، والفصول. بدأوا في قياس حياتهم بهذه التغيرات. ثم بدأ الناس باختراع الساعات. كانت بعض الساعات جميلة. كانت خاصة أجزاء متحركة معقدة جداً. كانت بعض الساعات شخصيات من الناس أو الحيوانات. وأخرى تعزف موسيقى. ساعات اليوم والساعات ……………….. إنها دقيقة للغة. تغير الساعة الطريقة التي ننظر بها إلى العالم. تقيس الساعة الوقت، لكن لا أحد يعرف ما هو.

1. How do we measure time?
2. Why is time a mystery?
3. How did the earliest people start measuring their lives?
4. Why is our ability to measure time important?
5. Some clocks had figures of people or animals. (True / False)
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer or complete (5) of title following sentences using information from your text book:   ( 10 M. )
1. Some people find out too late that:( a. work is not the only thing in life   b. they missed their holiday )
2. What frightened the shark away?
3. How could a banker convince people to use the bank?
4. Why do some officers direct traffic?
5. People save money for their retirement so that ..........
6. Interpreters have to have a degree after they do an interpreting diploma. (True / False)

Q2) Grammar and Functions: (30 Marks)
A/ Re-write the following sentences, follow the instructions between brackets. (Choose 10)   ( 20 M. )
1. ………….. if you do, ask a doctor for help with giving it up. (Use an imperative to give advice)
2. I ( play ) football a lot, but I ( not/ play ) very much now. (Use the correct form of "used to" and the present or past simple)
3. My brother is an architect. (He lives in China.) (Use the correct relative pronoun to make one sentence).
4. Unfortunately, I lost my phone, so I couldn't call Ali. (Regret use "If only ")
5. If you are offered a place at Carnegie University. (You accept) it? (Correct the form of the verb)
6. My mother told me to turn down the music. (Use the correct form of "make")
7. We've all been to the park last weekend. (Correct the sentence)
8. This is a new computer, so I think it is faster than the other one. ( Expectation use (should/ shouldn't )
9. She is going to her computer course tomorrow night. I found out she …………. (Future in the past)
10. I want to keep these pictures, so don't (throw / away / them). ( Put the verb and the object in the correct order)
11. (be , sold , The , end , house , will , before , the , year , the , of) . (Put in the correct order to make a passive sentence)
12. Where are you from? She asked me ………. (Reported question)

B/ Choose the correct word between brackets: ( 5 only )   ( 10 M. )
1. Have you ever (camp / camped) in the desert?
2. I'm (interesting/ interested) in joining the club.
3. If you don't hurry, you'll be late. The train (leaves / will leave) at 11.00.
4. She's been talking on the phone (with /for) the last 20 minutes.
5. We have plenty of time. We (need to/ needn't) hurry.
6. Streets are (dangerous / more dangerous) than they used to be.

Reading comprehension: (20 Mark)
Q1. A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10M.)

We all know that shopping online is useful. It saves time and effort. You can buy what you want any time. It's a form of electronic commerce which allows the users directly buy goods from a seller over the internet. However, my opinion changed when I decided to buy a present to my daughter on her birthday. I visited the websites for electronics until I found what I wanted and ordered a modern computer. The delivery arrived in one week. I opened the box. Inside, there were a keyboard, a mouse, a screen and a lot of wires. After spending an hour trying to. put all parts together, it still didn't work. At once called them to send it back. They were sorry. After three days, a new computer arrived. It was great and my daughter was happy., When you shop online, you need to be careful where you shop from. You should buy from trusted sources and make sure you read the user reviews of both the seller and the product.

كلنا نعلم أن التسوق عبر الإنترنت مفيد. إنه يوفّر الوقت والجهد. يمكنك شراء ما تريده في أي وقت. إنه شكل من أشكال التجارة الإلكترونية التي تسمح للمستخدمين بشراء السلع مباشرة من البائع عبر الإنترنت. لكن رأيي تغير عندما قررت شراء هدية لابنتي في عيد ميلادها. زرت مواقع الإلكترونيات حتى وجدت ما أريده وطلبت جهاز كمبيوتر حديث. وصل التسليم بعد أسبوع. فتحت الصندوق. من الداخل، كانت هناك لوحة مفاتيح، فأرة، شاشة والكثير من الأسلاك. وبعد قضاء ساعة في محاولة لتجميع جميع الأجزاء، لم يعمل الجهاز. اتصلت بهم على ………… تم ………… ………… …………Diagnostic على ………… ………… ………… ………… …………They ………… ………… …………Diagnosticو ………… ………… ………… …………واو ………… ………… …………部门的
خياراً بشأن المكان الذي تتسوق منه. يجب أن تكون حذراً بشأن المكان الذي تتسوق منه. يجب أن تشتري من مصادر موثوقة وتتأكد من قراءة تقييمات المستخدمين للبائع والمنتج.

1. What does the underlined pronoun "it" refer to?
2. Why was the writer's daughter happy?
3. When the writer opened the box, he found some pens and books. (True / False)
4. What is the main advantage of shopping online?
5. Why did the company send him a new computer?
6. The main idea of the passage is … ……. (a. shopping in the mall.    b. shopping online)
B/ Answer or complete (5) of the following sentences using information from your textbook:   (10 M.)
1. Why does a banker need to be a good communicator?
2. Samira read about the subject of oil in order to ..............
3. In what ways has wind power been used for thousands of years?
4. The paramedics spotted Mustafa's mother ............
5. How could the police avoid mistakes when using radar speed guns?
6. "Workaholics" are those people who ..........

Grammar and Functions: (30 Marks)
Q2.A/ Re-write the following sentences, follow the instructions between brackets. (Choose 10) (20 M.)
1. How long will I have to / keep on / it? (Put the verb and the object in the correct order)
2. She (walk) home from school when she heard the police siren. (Correct the form of the verb)
3. She is going to her computer course tomorrow night. I found out she ……………. (Future in the past)
4. "Where has she been?" I asked ……………. (Reported question)
5. Can I borrow that book after you? Here you are. I …… (Complete using "just" and an appropriate verb)
6. There (be) a house here, but they (knock) it down two years ago. (Use "used to" and the present or past simple)
7. My uncle deposited the money last week. (Write in the passive form)
8. If my alarm clock had gone off this morning, I (not oversleep). (Correct the form of the verb)
9. (see your ticket) (Polite request)
10. ……………………….. And brush your teeth three times a day. (Use an imperative to give advice)
11. A fee will be charged if you (not have) enough money in your account. (Correct the form of the verb)
12. My mother told me to turn down the music. (Use the correct form of "make")

B/ Choose the correct word between brackets: (5 only)   (10 M.)
1. I'll be all right. You (needn't / needn't to) worry about me.
2. My father, (who / whose) loves reading, buys two or three new books a week.
3. Put your case in the car. There's still a (few / little) space left.
4. If only my father had (gave / given) me a lift.
5. I have been waiting (since / for) 20 minutes.
6. He studied hard. He (should / shouldn't) fail the exam.

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور ثالث / 2024 / Oct.

Q1) Reading Comprehension (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

After a meeting, a wife was coming out of a hotel and she was looking for her car keys. They weren't in her pockets. She searched the meeting room, but they weren't there. She thought she left them in the car. Her husband had shouted many times for leaving the keys in the car because the car would be stolen. She hurried to the parking place. The parking was empty. She called the police and gave them her location, the car number and the description of the place where she parked her car. She said that she had left her keys in the car, and that it had been stolen. An hour later, the wife called her husband and told him what had happened. Her husband got angry and said, "I dropped you at the hotel." She was silent for a moment, then said, "Well, come and get me." He shouted, "I will as soon as the policeman becomes sure that I haven't stolen your car."

1. The husband was often ............... (a. pleased  /   b. angry)
2. The wife left the keys in the car. (True / False)
3. Why did the wife call her husband?
4. When the wife went back to the parking place, the car was .............  (a. broken  /  b. not there)
5. Why did the wife call the police?
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer (5) of the following sentences using information from your text-book:   (10 M.)
1. The pressure of life ................. (a. cause health problems   b. kill us)
2. The writer wants to find a job in his country. (True / False)
3. What frightened the shark away?
4. Bankers only need to know about financial subjects. (True / False)
5. What is the most important aspect of wind power?
6. What is a radar detector?

Q2) Grammar and Functions:   (30 Marks)
A/ Rewrite the following sentences, follow the instructions between brackets.  (Choose 10)   (20 M.)
1. He asked somebody to cut his hair. (Rewrite using the correct form of "have")
2. Somebody left these books in the classroom. (Rewrite in the passive form)
3. Adam has come back from Beirut yesterday. (Correct the sentence)
4. Bashir is going to buy a car very soon. (He passed his driving test last week.) (Use the correct relative pronoun to make one sentence)
5. Can I borrow some money? She asked me ……………………. (Reported questions)
6. I (think) about you and then you (ring) me. (Put one verb in the past continuous and one in the past simple)
7. Ali would be really happy if he (can) spend the summer studying in London. (Correct the form of the verb)
8. …………………………. And brush your teeth three times a day. (Use an imperative to give advice)
9. Define an engineer. (Use: designs and builds machines, engines or roads)
10. She's going to her computer course tomorrow night. I found out she ……………………………. (Future in the past)
